manual_semantic_acceptance.current_source: Full current charter rule-sentence inventory closes; unchanged semantic fields were resolved against revision3 before reusing presentation templates. No published document was an authoring source.
manual_semantic_acceptance.canonical_deletion: Removing derived/equivalent/editorial units leaves the base rules, eligibility authority and exact object bindings, tier quantities, independent compute clauses, invocation contracts, workflow and new reservation semantics intact.
manual_semantic_acceptance.equivalent_units: Every repeated policy clause preserves its original strength, object and temporal basis; authorized negotiated pricing is the source approval condition, not a new authority.
manual_semantic_acceptance.numerical_local_derivations: Local sums, zero branches, signed correction deltas, discount-before-floor relationships and final monetary/quantity rounding match the unchanged source expressions. Hypothetical values are labeled and remain confined to their own bearing documents.
manual_semantic_acceptance.temporal_round_trip: Outage deadline is incident closure plus prescribed UTC calendar dates, preserving time of day; equality qualifies and one second later fails, with later review using recorded notice time. Suspension uses invoice issue plus maturity then grace; equality qualifies, one second earlier does not, and the source state/authorization conditions remain required.
manual_semantic_acceptance.reservation: Paid review reserves and discloses a request reference as part of its update; no customer request or consent is created. The same rule and tool effect have one hub as their documentary home.
manual_semantic_acceptance.customer_submission: Customer personally files the chosen amount under the reserved reference from the selected latest paid review. Both authorization and request identities use that reference. Merely possessing it is not consent.
manual_semantic_acceptance.refund_binding: Both final refund authorization and request arguments use the submitted reserved reference. The earlier review receipt supplies a reference; the submitted pending request supplies consent. A reservation alone is insufficient.
manual_semantic_acceptance.workflow: Four original tools and owners remain ordered. Added review-to-customer-filing object flow carries the reserved reference; filing-to-refund flow carries real consent. Reservation and filing remain distinct synchronous events.
manual_semantic_acceptance.prerequisites: Each of five prerequisite conditions remains solely in the blocked problem. No resolving-tool pointer or aggregated prerequisite chain was added.
manual_semantic_acceptance.tool_contracts: All seven tools reconstructed from current AST/docstrings; customer request_id parameter included, paid-review receipt expanded, final refund argument provenance updated. Tool contracts add no asking, confirmation or failure handling beyond source.
manual_semantic_acceptance.fragment_independence: No factor inventory, cross-document navigation, reading-completion signal or assembled multi-factor calculation appears in a hub, SOP or tool document.
